opening.argument: The method is presented as a no-cost, risk-free path to limitless ETH, yet it requires viewers to connect MetaMask, select accounts, deploy an externally linked contract, and move ETH between their own wallets. The speaker says, "The connect Connect button and wait for MetaMask to open. Now that MetaMask is open, select the active accounts with the help of the Select All button. Grant the connection in MetaMask" and ties the amount of ETH confirmed in a second account to increased automatic earnings. The instructions then require repeated transfers to increase purported returns, including a claim of more than 0.05 ETH within minutes. The tutorial and claimed demonstration do not verify the code, wallet permissions, contract behavior, or whether the displayed profits were obtainable.

citations.quote: The connect Connect button and wait for MetaMask to open. Now that MetaMask is open, select the active accounts with the help of the Select All button. Grant the connection in MetaMask
The more Ethereum you have confirmed on your second Metamask account, the more transactions you can confirm, increasing your earnings automatically.
If you want to increase your earnings, you need to increase liquidity repeatedly, conducting technical transfer of Ethereum between your accounts.
So, that will be profit of more then 0.05 ETH in just a few minutes of automatic transaction processing.
